qa_pairs.instruction: What are the three post‑installation actions required for the PeopleSoft 52 driver?
qa_pairs.output: After installing and configuring the PeopleSoft 52 driver you must (1) deploy the driver, (2) start the driver, and (3) activate the driver. Each action is described in the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you deploy the PeopleSoft 52 driver?
qa_pairs.output: To deploy the PeopleSoft 52 driver, open the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide, locate the "Deploying the Driver" section (linked as ../../../identity-manager-48/driver_admin/data/create-driver-object-designer.html#t4d513qr1e2l), and follow the step‑by‑step procedure described there.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you start the PeopleSoft 52 driver after it has been deployed?
qa_pairs.output: To start the PeopleSoft 52 driver, refer to the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide, go to the "Starting the Driver" section (linked as ../../../identity-manager-48/driver_admin/data/create-driver-object-designer.html#t4d5143qhvur), and execute the steps outlined in that section.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you activate the PeopleSoft 52 driver once it is started?
qa_pairs.output: To activate the PeopleSoft 52 driver, consult the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide, find the "Activating Drivers" chapter (linked as ../../../identity-manager-48/driver_admin/data/b1db8oqk.html#b1db8oqk), and follow the activation instructions provided there.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the steps required to bring the PeopleSoft 52 driver into operational use after installation.
qa_pairs.output: After installing and configuring the PeopleSoft 52 driver, you must (1) deploy the driver, (2) start the driver, and (3) activate the driver. Detailed procedures for each step are available in the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide under the respective sections: Deploying the Driver, Starting the Driver, and Activating Drivers.
